acceptance.assertion: Given the pinned shared queue and generated @toy/contracts artifacts, when both checked-out application transactions and native pg-boss worker transactions run the fault spike, job/domain rollback and lost-claim fencing pass through executeSql, the five schemas validate with their declared dialect, and no homemade polling queue or second schema owner is needed.

nativePublicApiEvidence.api: PgBoss constructor accepts ConstructorOptions; getDb(): types.IDatabase
IDatabase.executeSql(text: string, values?: unknown[]): Promise<{ rows: any[] }>; optional beginTransaction(): Promise<TransactionHandle>; TransactionHandle exposes db, commit(), rollback()
ConnectionOptions.db?: IDatabase; SendOptions = JobOptions & QueueOptions & ConnectionOptions
send(name, data, options); work(name, options, handler); offWork(name, { wait }); cancel(name, id); getJobById(name, id); deleteAllJobs(name); deleteQueue(name); stop(options)
WorkOptions.transactional?: boolean; work(name, { transactional: true }, handler) supplies TransactionalWorkHandler(jobs, tx: IDatabase)
Native worker opens a transaction, runs handler and completion in it, and throws when the completion no longer owns the claim; catch rolls the handler transaction back
Public cancel delegates to the native cancellation plan; active cancellation can remove the claim used by the worker completion fence

implementationShape.callerLifecycle: Parent integration calls QueueFaultProbe.exercise inside the existing packages/self-improvement/src/accounting-postgres.ts withAccountingFixture lifecycle and passes that lifecycle's ModelAdmissionConnectionV1.
implementationShape.connectionFence: Require test context, inspect the owned ready R0 fake-clock/fake-model stack, socketDirectory /private/tmp/toy-pg-${stackId}, database toy, peerRole userInfo().username, and connect to port 5432.
implementationShape.applicationTransaction: PgBoss.getDb().beginTransaction() checks out a native transaction handle. Write the fixed domain marker through tx.db.executeSql, call boss.send(queue, payload, { db: tx.db }), and test rollback versus commit with native job and domain readbacks.
implementationShape.workerTransactions: Use the pinned native boss.work(queue, { transactional: true }) handler; write only through the supplied tx.executeSql. Throw after the write for rollback, then use an entered/release promise barrier and public boss.cancel for lost-claim fencing.
implementationShape.workerWaits: The only queue consumer is pg-boss's native worker poller. Probe synchronization uses promise barriers, native offWork({wait:true}), bounded waits, and getJobById readbacks; there is no custom queue polling loop.
implementationShape.domainState: One fixed disposable public.toy_ops_queue_spike relation; all marker SQL is parameterized and scoped by owned stack ID plus probe request ID. No SQL references pg-boss tables.
implementationShape.resourceLimits: PgBoss pool max 2, fixture PostgreSQL max_connections 4, UNIX socket only, fixed statement/lock timeouts, native scheduling/supervision disabled, and handler/client cleanup in finally.
implementationShape.schemaOwner: Ops uses obligationToolParameters Zod schemas and the contracts-owned validateObligationToolParameters / obligationToolSchemaDialect functions plus schemaBundleArtifacts. Ops does not import Ajv or read schema files directly.

fixedFalsificationCases.applicationRollback: Marker insert and native send share one checked-out pg-boss transaction; after rollback, getJobById is null and marker readback is absent.
fixedFalsificationCases.applicationCommitControl: Same checked-out transaction commits both marker and job; public readback sees both, then public cancel/readback proves the job can be cleaned before workers start.
fixedFalsificationCases.nativeWorkerThrow: Native transactional handler writes marker with tx.executeSql then throws a fixed error; after offWork wait the job is failed and marker is absent.
fixedFalsificationCases.nativeLostClaim: Native transactional handler writes marker then blocks; public cancel makes readback cancelled before release; after worker settlement marker is absent and job remains cancelled.

schemas.toy_capture: Valid create, amend with explicit patch null, and attach; reject unknown property and empty amend patch.
schemas.toy_due: Accept minimal payload with now/through/cursor omitted and a second payload with those keys explicitly null; reject unknown property and duplicate UUID ids.
schemas.toy_resolve: Accept fixed resolve payload; reject unknown property.
schemas.toy_defer: Accept until and dependency variants; reject unknown property and duplicate dependency UUIDs.
schemas.toy_satisfy: Accept fixed satisfy payload; reject unknown property.
schemas.dialect: For all five tools, require the declared URI https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema and require both source Zod and generated Ajv validation results to match the fixed expectations. Contracts validator options are coerceTypes=false, removeAdditional=false, useDefaults=false.
